title: Only 6.2% of Canada Is Farmland #shorts
summary: In 2021, 6.2% of Canada's land (the ten provinces) was farm area. Frozen ground and rock cover much of the rest.
sources: In 2021, 6.2% of Canada's land was reported as total farm area (national data exclude the three territories) (Statistics Canada, Canadian Agriculture at a Glance, 20 Oct 2022, 2021 Census of Agriculture): https://www150.statcan.gc.ca/n1/pub/96-325-x/2021001/article/00012-eng.htm

About 50 per cent of Canada is underlain by permafrost (40-50 per cent in the Regions section) (The Canadian Encyclopedia, Permafrost, edited 10 Aug 2015): https://thecanadianencyclopedia.ca/en/article/permafrost

At 5 million km2, the Shield makes up roughly 50 per cent of Canada's land mass; bare rock, thin soils, muskeg; thousands of small lakes (The Canadian Encyclopedia, Canadian Shield, edited 11 Aug 2021): https://thecanadianencyclopedia.ca/en/article/shield

scenes.narration: Only {6.2%|six point two percent} of Canada's land is farmland.
Up north, about half the country sits on permafrost.
In the middle: the rock of the Canadian Shield.
The farms are in the south: the Prairies and by the Great Lakes.
So most Canadians live near the farms, and the farms fit in just {6.2%|six point two percent}.
